_howToEdit: Change only the words on the right of each colon, keep the double quotes, and write \" for a quote mark inside the text. Keep anything in {curly brackets}: the extension fills those in. Then save, and the checks say if anything is wrong.

manifest.name: Spoiler Blocker for GTA 6
manifest.description: Hides GTA 6 spoilers across the web by checking pages against an automatically updated spoiler list.

store.name: Spoiler Blocker for GTA 6
store.summary: Hides GTA 6 spoilers on social sites, video sites, search and news. Works in your browser; the spoiler list updates itself.
description: Avoid GTA 6 story spoilers while you browse.

The extension blurs posts, videos, comments and search results that would give away the story: who dies, twists, endings, the final missions and the names that reveal them. Everything else on the page stays as it is.
- Works on YouTube, Reddit, X, Bluesky, Facebook, Instagram, Twitch, Kick, Discord, Steam, Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo, Gmail, and basic support for other websites.
- Hides the whole post or comment, not just a word, so the rest of a thread stays readable.
- Hides everything from known spoiler accounts, whatever their posts say.
- You choose how much to protect: only the big moments, the main story (the default), or everything.
- Blur, collapse or remove; click or hold to peek; pause it, or set a day it stops.
- Safe and strict site lists, your own words to hide, and words never to hide.
- The spoiler list updates by itself while the game's wikis fill in.
- It reads words, not meaning: a comment that tells the story in plain words, with no name or spoiler word in it, can still get through.
Private by design: pages are read only inside your browser. No account, no tracking, no analytics. The only download is the spoiler list itself.
Not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. Grand Theft Auto and GTA are trademarks of Take-Two Interactive.

welcome.title: Thank you for installing Spoiler Blocker for GTA 6
welcome.intro: Spoiler Blocker hides GTA 6 spoilers on the pages you visit: Reddit, YouTube, X, search results and everywhere else. It reads pages only inside your browser, looks for matches with a list of spoilers, and hides the content when it finds one. Nothing about what you browse is sent anywhere. The extension's code is open source on GitHub.
welcome.pick: How much do you want hidden?
welcome.change: You can change this any time.
welcome.pin: Tip: pin the extension to your toolbar with the puzzle-piece icon. From there you can pause it or mark a site as safe. In private (Incognito) windows Chrome keeps extensions off until you turn on Allow in Incognito on the extension's details page.
welcome.saved: Saved. You can change this any time.
welcome.howto: Click the label on anything hidden to see it. Finished the game? Just switch it off in the popup. It reads words, not meaning: a comment that tells the story in plain words, with no name or spoiler word in it, can still get through.
welcome.launchPick: Hide every post about GTA 6 for the first days after release?
welcome.launchHelp: This catches things before the spoiler list knows them, like new features nobody has written up yet. It also hides harmless posts during that time.

light.name: Light blur

trailers.help: Hides a post that names GTA 6 and says trailer, trailers or teaser. It goes by those words only.

all.name: Hide the replies under it too
all.help: Replies to a spoiler usually repeat it, so the whole chain goes behind one label. One click shows them all.

own.name: Hide only that comment
own.help: Each reply is checked by itself. A reply that hints at the spoiler without naming anything will show.

off.name: Do not blur pictures just for being near the name

page.name: Only on pages that mention GTA 6
page.help: On a page whose title, heading or address mentions GTA 6, like a GTA 6 subreddit or a search for GTA 6, every large picture and video is blurred, harmless ones too. Words stay readable, and one click shows a picture. Not in Casual, or when How careful is "Light: only obvious spoilers".

post.name: Also next to any post that mentions GTA 6: recommended
post.help: The choice above, and also any large picture on any page when the post or caption next to it mentions GTA 6, and the small preview picture of such a post on Reddit. Words stay readable, and one click shows a picture. Not in Casual, or when How careful is "Light: only obvious spoilers".

show.name: Show them
show.help: A GIF posted as a reply with no words of its own about the game, and with a clean description, is shown, even on a page about the game. Recommended: reaction GIFs are almost always harmless. A game clip posted as a GIF reply stays visible too. The post's own pictures, quoted posts, link cards, galleries and video are still covered.

cover.name: Cover them like other pictures
cover.help: Reply GIFs without a description are covered like any other picture next to the name of the game. Safer, but harmless reaction GIFs get covered too. A GIF from a GIF library that has a description is judged by 'Reaction GIFs from a GIF library' above, whatever this says.

show.name: Show them
show.help: A photo or picture posted as a reply with no words of its own about the game, and with a clean description, is shown, even on a page about the game. A spoiler screenshot posted as a bare reply stays visible too. The post's own pictures, quoted posts, link cards, galleries and video are still covered.

cover.name: Cover them like other pictures
cover.help: Reply photos are covered like any other picture next to the name of the game. Recommended: it also covers a spoiler screenshot posted as a bare reply, at the price of covering harmless photos too.

label.name: Judge them by their label (default)
label.help: A reaction GIF from a GIF library is hidden only when its label or title gives something away. Otherwise it shows, even next to the name of the game. A spoiler GIF with a harmless-sounding label can slip through; pick the other choice if you want no risk.

picture.name: Always cover them like pictures
picture.help: Reaction GIFs are treated like any other picture, so they are covered whenever the pictures above would be. Safer, but harmless GIFs get covered too.

No entry: nothing is shown. v0_1_2 is never shown to people (0.1.2 shipped before this existed); it only gives the tests a note for that build.

Official trailers from the game's maker and the big outlets are let through when you allow trailers.
A video under a cover stays paused and muted until you show it.
v0_1_3: Choose Pictures per site or per group, like Livestream sites or YouTube, from the right-click menu or the popup.
Each cover says why it is there and which setting caused it, with a Change this link.
Picture-only posts cover just the picture, and one press on a cover shows the whole post.

Fixes for Instagram, Reddit, Facebook, X, Gmail, Discord, Google and YouTube.
v0_1_4: Turn off on this page: one click in the popup, with Undo.
Twitch and Kick live streams stay clear and keep their sound. Replays and clips are judged like any video.
X: a spoiler written into a name or handle, even run together, is covered. Plain names stay.
Facebook: comments under a covered post are covered with it.
Discord: Klipy GIFs that give nothing away no longer stay covered.

howToUpdate.step1: Download the latest zip from {link}: the file ending in -chrome.zip, not "Source code".

howToUpdate.step3: Open chrome://extensions and press Reload on this extension's card, then refresh the pages you have open.
howToUpdate.stay: Your settings stay as long as you use the same folder.

updates.name: Spoiler update frequency
updates.help: How often the extension downloads the newest spoiler list. A job watches the GTA wikis and adds new names; your browser only downloads the finished list.
updates.privacyNote: The list is never shown, so updating can not spoil you.
updates.failed: The last try, {when}, did not work: {why}

failedWhy.network: the update server could not be reached.
failedWhy.invalid: the downloaded list was not valid, so the old one was kept.

result.wait: You just checked. Please wait a minute before checking again.

text.revealAll: Show everything hidden on this page
text.safeResumeHelp: Nothing is hidden here until you resume.
text.markSafeHelp: Stop hiding here. Pick how much:
text.coversMention: Only when the page mentions GTA 6
